semiconductor_relevance: High — Suzhou Xinshangsi specializes in automation equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on wafer handling and inspection systems.
summary: Suzhou Xinshangsi Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-end equipment manufacturer that provides customized automation solutions for intelligent manufacturing in the semiconductor sector. They focus on developing wafer transfer systems, inspection systems, and automated transmission systems, supported by a professional R&D team and comprehensive technical services.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Suzhou, China, and operates within the Lansheng Science and Technology Park.
